name: Hamanaka Tsubomi
source:
She is a first-year student at St. Nympho's Academy and a new member of the Bitch Club, like the main character.

She is pale, has short bobbed black hair, and short with glamorous body. She looks like a puppy dog.

She looks innocent and fragile, but she decided to join the Bitch Club in order to change her own personality, and she also puts her name forward for the head of the club.

She's the only one with a proper conscience in the Bitch Club.

[From [url=http://www.ordin-soft.com/bitchclub.html#charactor]official site[/url]]
translation:
圣宁芙学园一年级学生，也是和主人公一样刚加入淫乱部的新成员。

她肤色苍白，留着黑色短波波头，个子娇小，身材却很性感，看起来像一只小狗。

她外表天真脆弱，却为了改变自己的性格而决定加入淫乱部，还主动竞选部长。

她是淫乱部里唯一还有正常良知的人。
